gloss: peaceful and uneventful; safe and sound

definitions.gloss: peaceful and uneventful; safe and sound; tranquil
definitions.explanation: A state in which nothing troublesome or dangerous occurs; everything proceeds calmly and without incident.

examples.japanese: {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}な{日々|ひび}を{送|おく}る。
{旅行|りょこう}は{平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}に{終|お}わった。
{平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}に{暮|く}らせることが{何|なに}よりの{幸|しあわ}せだと{年|とし}を{重|かさ}ねるごとに{感|かん}じる。
examples.english: With each passing year, I feel more that being able to live peacefully and without trouble is the greatest happiness.

notes:
FORMATION: A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) composed of {平穏|へいおん} (peaceful, calm) + {無事|ぶじ} (without incident, safe). Both halves reinforce the same meaning.

USAGE: Used as a na-adjective ({平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}な) or adverbially ({平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}に). Often expresses gratitude or a wish for continued peace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}な{生活|せいかつ}: a peaceful life
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}に{過|す}ごす: to spend time peacefully
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}に{終|お}わる: to end without incident

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平穏無事|へいおんぶじ}: peaceful and incident-free (four-character compound)
- {平穏|へいおん}: peaceful, calm (shorter form)
- {無事|ぶじ}: safe, without incident (shorter form)
- {安泰|あんたい}: safe and secure, stable
